title: auth: /api/v1/auth/config reports disableSignUp: false under the default invite_only audience posture — the console offers Sign up, then the form is refused 403
body:
Filing gate: ① product defect — a machine-readable surface contradicts the server's own behaviour (AGENTS.md, Route & surface ownership rule 4: "Machine-readable surfaces must not lie"); `reach:` measured through public HTTP entries and the console UI.
Reader: triage seat first-touch → the lane that owns `plugin-auth`'s public auth config and the `auth` settings manifest (expected `domain:services`).
Dedup (semantic search, open + closed): objectstack "self-registration invite_only audience posture but sign up link shown, disableSignUp signup_enabled contradiction" → 4 hits, all closed and related, none a duplicate (#11739 introduced the posture with default `invite_only`; objectstack-ai/objectstack#20389 and objectstack-ai/objectstack#20413 concern email verification under `open`); objectui "auth config disableSignUp reports sign-up open while posture invite_only, login page Sign up link" → 5 hits, all closed; objectui#11634 fixed the client so that `disableSignUp: true` hides the link — this card is about the server never sending `true` here.

## Reach — measured on a stock showcase boot

Framework `ce577ec4`, `objectstack dev --seed-admin`, fresh SQLite, no `auth.audience` declared (so the posture is the `invite_only` default).

1. `GET /api/v1/auth/config` → `{"emailPassword":{"enabled":true,"disableSignUp":false,"requireEmailVerification":false}, …}`.
2. `POST /api/v1/auth/sign-up/email` with `{"name":"QA","email":"qa.person3@example.com","password":"Passw0rd!123"}` → **403** `{"code":"SELF_REGISTRATION_CLOSED","message":"Self-registration is closed on this environment (audience posture invite_only). Ask an administrator for an invitation."}`.
3. Console `/login` renders "Don't have an account? Sign up" — the console hides that link only when the config says `disableSignUp === true` (objectui `apps/console/src/pages/auth/LoginPage.tsx`). Following it, `/register` shows the full form; submitting it shows "Self-registration is not open on this environment. Ask an administrator for an invitation." only after the user has filled in every field.
4. Setup → Settings → Authentication renders both "Allow self-service registration" switched **on** (`GET /api/settings/auth` → `signup_enabled` `{"value":true,"source":"default"}`) and "Self-registration audience: Invitation only — no self-registration (default)" (`audience_posture` `{"value":"invite_only","source":"default"}`). Two controls for one decision, with contradicting effective values, both at their defaults.

## Expected

Whatever the effective posture decides is what the config advertises: under `invite_only`, `disableSignUp: true`, so no client offers a form the server will refuse; and the Authentication settings page cannot show self-registration as allowed while the posture closes it.

Provenance: maintainer instruction in the dispatching session, verbatim — 「把这些问题提成 issue」. Found during a browser dogfood sweep of the console; filed by session `session_01WEARdKfDHDT7rTuEhLyT1k`.
